title: finding(scripts): a census assertion message says `outside the ruled family` where the instrument files `unruled` — it answers a question that is open in the decision box
body:
Path: none | instrument prose vs instrument | 不升级类

Raised by the **at-tier** contract review of PR objectui#9895 round 7 (record `5737896894`,
`VERDICT: PASS`), which graded it **below FAIL** and named the repair as a two-word change.
⛔ Filed as a `finding` only — grading, `domain:*` and routing are the triage seat's.
⛔ **Not a revert**, and ⛔ not a reason to have held that PR: no measurement is contradicted.

## The shape

`objectui#9871`'s producer scan files every surviving producer under the disposition
**`unruled:item-carrier`** — the word is *unruled*, and the card itself is currently
`needs-user-decision` with A/B/C on its face, i.e. **a human is deciding it right now**.

PR objectui#9895 (merged from `claude/issue-6771-body-dialect-retirement`) re-points two of that
scan's assertions, correctly. But two pieces of its prose say something stronger than the instrument:

| site | what it says | what the instrument says |
|:--|:--|:--|
| the census test, assertion message (~line 397) | the surviving rows are 「item-carried and **outside the ruled family**」 | `unruled:item-carrier` |
| the same file, gloss (~line 477) | `unruled:item-carrier` means 「⛔ **not** objectui#6771's ruled family」 | `unruled` |

⇒ an **assertion message a future dev acts on** states an answer to a question sitting in the
maintainer's decision box. 「Outside the ruled family」 is defensible as 「not within the five steps as
ruled today」 — ⚠️ but that is a reading a reader has to supply, and the file's own disposition
constant does not supply it.

## The fix

Make the shipped sentence say what the report and the instrument already say: **`unruled`**. Two words,
in two places, in `scripts/__tests__/body-dialect-census.test.ts`. ⛔ Nothing else moves, ⛔ no assertion
changes, ⛔ no revert of the re-pointing (which the review measured as mandatory and correct — `main`'s
`toBeGreaterThan(0)` would otherwise have gone red on that head with no green path except deleting it,
and objectui#9871's own text says 「re-point … do not delete」).

## Why it is filed rather than fixed in place

The PM seat ⛔ never writes code. ⭐ And it is filed **with an owner named** rather than left as
「whoever touches that file next」 — an unowned end-condition is how a temporary state becomes
permanent, which is the exact shape objectui#9961 was filed about.

## Provenance, and what is ⛔ not claimed

- The review's own words: 「**(c) for that phrase only**: the seat should have it say 'unruled' so the
  instrument, the report and the shipped sentence agree; a two-word change, not a revert, and graded
  below FAIL because no measurement is contradicted and the branch does not need the ruling to be
  correct.」
- ⛔ This card does **not** re-open whether a dev seat may rewrite another card's landed judgement
  prose at all. The review calls that 「a process question above both seats」, the implementer flagged
  it itself, and it stays where it is.
- ⚠️ The line numbers above are the review's, ⛔ not re-measured by this seat; read the file, not the
  digits. The two phrases are the anchor.
- Dedupe: 429 unique objectui issues **and PRs, open and closed**, plus every `needs-user-decision`
  card in both states, read 2026-09-19T00:39:12Z — 「outside the ruled family」 **0**,
  `unruled:item-carrier` **2** (objectui#9871, objectui#9940 — the sibling card and its PR, ⛔ not this
  finding). Lit control `body-dialect-census` → **8**; fresh absent-token control → **0**.

Part of objectui#6771. Sibling: objectui#9871.
